'''Eva Kaayz''' was a [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] chief operations [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation's]] weapons division during the era of the [[Galactic War]]. Before the [[Seizure of CZ-198]], she approached the [[Imperial Ordnance Acquisition Corps]] to negotiate terms for information on the classified facility in exchange for an unknown price.<ref name="Titans" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eva Kaayz was added to the [[2011]] [[Roleplaying game|massively-multiplayer online roleplaying]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3: Titans of Industry on [[August 6]], [[2013]].<ref name="Welcome to Update 2.3">{{TORweb|url=blog/welcome-game-update-2.3|text=Welcome to Game Update 2.3}}</ref> Kaayz functions as the entry point into the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] storyline for the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[CZ-198]].<ref name="Titans" />

During the storyline, Kaayz is a romance option for players of any gender. Players can flirt with her during the introductory conversation, and after the storyline concludes, can choose to share a drink with Kaayz and spend time with her offscreen. After this point, the player can no longer interact with Kaayz or pursue a long-term romance.<ref name="Titans" />
